description:
Live an entire life, one year at a time.

ReLife is a choice-driven life simulator where careers, money, relationships, habits, and unexpected events combine into a story that changes with every decision. Start a new life, grow older, and decide who your character becomes - from an ordinary worker to a business owner, politician, artist, criminal, social media star, or chess champion.

Choose an education, find work, build skills, manage your finances, invest, buy property and vehicles, and take opportunities that can change your future.

Follow your own path:
Grow businesses and compete in the market, enter politics, pursue creative and competitive careers, break the law, make headlines, or focus on family and a quieter life.

Build relationships:
Meet partners, make friends, raise children, deal with ex-partners and family decisions, and see how the people around you shape your story.

Live with consequences:
Small choices can affect later years. Success, setbacks, habits, unexpected events, and an evolving world make every life different.

Leave a legacy:
When a life ends, review its achievements, wealth, relationships, and defining moments. Continue through an heir when available, or begin a completely new story.

Features:
• Year-by-year life progression
• Careers, education, business, politics, crime, art, social media, chess, and more

The question changes at midnight. Tallest. Richest. Most followed. Oldest.
